parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top cover of the trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic, designed to open and close for waste disposal.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents odors from escaping and keeps the contents enclosed. It can be lifted or flipped open for inserting trash.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or hinge open and close depending on the design.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is the outer frame or edge reinforcement of the trashcan, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and aesthetic finish to the trashcan, ensuring stability and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container section of the trashcan, made of polypropylene plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the waste and provides the main volume for storage. It supports the lid and outlier structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the main structural component.
